title: Distribution of volatile organic compounds in soil vapor in the vicinity of a Defense Fuel Supply Point, Hanahan, South Carolina
citation: Robertson, J.F., Aelion, C.M., and Vroblesky, D.A., 1993, Distribution of volatile organic compounds in soil vapor in the vicinity of a Defense Fuel Supply Point, Hanahan, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 93-4176, map scale 1:4,170.
notes: Soil-vapor VOC reconnaissance (1990) at a Defense Fuel Supply Point near Hanahan, S.C.; no named stratigraphic units, borings or structures. Recorded the water-table aquifer depth and stream-bottom setting. Not recorded: soil-vapor total response, toluene/ethylbenzene concentrations (table 1) and activated-carbon flux values (table 2), which are contaminant data outside scope; figure pages (maps) have only scattered labels. References: recorded the SC site reports and the two Vroblesky soil-gas method papers; skipped Brock 1990, Brower 1987, Malley 1985 (general methods). The McClelland 1987 reference is run together with the RMT 1988 entry in the text layer; only its own part is quoted. The RMT 1989 and 1990 entries use a dash for the author; the author name is filled in as inferred.
